# office_encrypt v0.1.1 - Table of Contents

Encrypt Office Open XML documents (.xlsx, .docx, .pptx) with a password using ECMA-376 Agile Encryption.

## Pages

- [OfficeEncrypt](https://office-encrypt.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [OfficeEncrypt](https://office-encrypt.hexdocs.pm/OfficeEncrypt.md): Encrypts Office Open XML documents (.xlsx, .docx, .pptx) with a password.
